note: CRIM lists its Puerto Rico parcelario services (crim_parcelas, 2018; crim_feb_2025) in the SIGEJP ArcGIS folder, but both return HTTP 500 'Service not started' on every query, so no usable parcel service is reachable. No other public parcel service covers Utuado: the Ponce PARCELAS layer is Ponce-only and the Utuado ArcGIS items found are boundaries, analysis files or landslide layers. CRIM parcel data reportedly is not freely shared.
